# simulate.compat.simulate_fmri_matrix { #fmrimod.simulate.compat.simulate_fmri_matrix }

```python
simulate_fmri_matrix(
    n=1,
    total_time=240.0,
    TR=2.0,
    hrf='spmg1',
    n_events=10,
    onsets=None,
    isi_dist='even',
    isi_min=2.0,
    isi_max=6.0,
    isi_rate=0.25,
    durations=0.0,
    duration_sd=0.0,
    duration_dist='lognormal',
    amplitudes=1.0,
    amplitude_sd=0.0,
    amplitude_dist='lognormal',
    single_trial=False,
    noise_type='none',
    noise_ar=None,
    noise_sd=1.0,
    random_seed=None,
    verbose=False,
    buffer=16.0,
)
```

Simulate an fMRI matrix dataset plus generation metadata.

Returns keys mirroring fmrireg:
``time_series``, ``ampmat``, ``durmat``, ``hrf_info``, ``noise_params``.
